decision: Close the zero-thread regression with the exact expected controlled difference and select a bounded current-upstream readiness assessment. The confirmed public path can silently report unchecked declarations as error-free, so verifying currentness and duplicate state and preparing a reviewable regression package offers more immediate ecosystem value than another speculative survivor witness.

categories.assessment: The source-derived prediction now has controlled executable evidence. A current-source and duplicate-report readiness assessment is the smallest next step that can convert it into responsible ecosystem action without prematurely submitting anything; transfer and historical CVC continuation remain gated.

The committed configs, existing 601-byte pair, two exact binaries and raw process ledger form a reusable regression package. The separate one-thread operational boundary lacks a deterministic resource witness, and the remaining cache alternatives already share a bounded internal distinction and export boundary.

The zero-worker result is now strong enough to justify a currentness and duplicate check, but not an external write. No new maintainer response or restored Arena access trigger is recorded, so this Nanoda-specific readiness package is the highest-value maintenance work.

Reuse the exact fixed pair, source assessment and raw ledger; no new general method or literature survey is needed. The transfer route still lacks independently curated input, while CVC-4 cannot inherit later successor evidence retroactively.

A bounded read-only currentness and duplicate assessment is feasible after a committed request protocol and requires no build or checker. Transfer has no supplied independent package and the original CVC-4 scientific gate remains unsatisfied.

candidates.rationale: The fixed pair matched exactly, all regression assets and receipts are local, and a finite read-only current-source and duplicate-report assessment can produce a GO, NO_GO or exact blocker without external mutation.
